title: RocksDB overview
summary: RocksDB is an embeddable persistent key-value store for fast storage. RocksDB was started at Facebook as a fork of LevelDB.

key_points.claim: RocksDB is an embeddable persistent key-value store for fast storage
key_points.quote: RocksDB is an embeddable persistent key-value store for fast storage.

key_points.claim: RocksDB was started at Facebook as a fork of LevelDB
key_points.quote: RocksDB was started at Facebook as a fork of LevelDB.

key_points.claim: Its storage engine is an LSM tree tuned for flash drives
